scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before an R&B stadium concert with a restrictive bag policy, [X] selects lower garments with separate deep or closable pockets for the phone, card, and stripped-down car key, then tests their security while navigating steep stairs, sitting on hard seats, filming, and dancing for hours.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加执行严格限包规定的 R&B 体育场演唱会前，[X]选择带有分区深口袋或可闭合口袋的下装，分别放置手机、卡片和精简后的车钥匙，并在陡峭台阶、硬座、拍摄和长时间舞动中检验安全性。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After losing a document bag in Paris, [X] selects pocketless lower garments and keeps the phone, daily wallet, and documents in one closed front-worn money belt, avoiding exposed rear positions and the need to search several places in metro crowds.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 曾在巴黎丢失证件袋后，[X]选择不带口袋的下装，把手机、当日钱包和证件统一放进前背的封闭腰包，避开暴露的后侧位置，也避免在地铁人群中到处翻找。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a hot Italian holiday, [X] selects pocketless tailored shorts or trousers because a front-worn zippered crossbody already carries every essential while preserving a cool, church-appropriate, dinner-ready silhouette.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为炎热的意大利假期准备时，[X]选择不带口袋的合身短裤或长裤，因为前背拉链斜挎包已经容纳全部必需品，同时保留凉爽、适合教堂参观和晚餐的整洁轮廓。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before machine-washing an owned suit, [X] empties every pocket of the trousers for pens, receipts, and coins, closes the fly, and uses a mesh bag, accepting the preparation because the pockets remain useful in formal wear.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 机洗已有的西装前，[X]从西裤的每个口袋取出笔、票据和硬币，合上门襟并使用网袋；由于这些口袋在正式穿着中仍有用途，[X]接受额外准备步骤。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a long school day, [X] simplifies an influencer look to jeans, a statement top, and sneakers and chooses jeans with secure pockets so a transit card, phone, and one small essential remain accessible between classes without opening the backpack.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了漫长的上课日，[X]把网红穿搭简化为牛仔裤、醒目上衣和运动鞋，并选择带可靠口袋的牛仔裤，使交通卡、手机和一件小必需品在课间无需打开背包即可取用。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a low-cost Rio beach trip, [X] selects pocketless lower garments and carries only the phone, wallet, and limited cash in one concealed under-clothing pouch, leaving nonessential valuables at the hostel before moving through metro, streets, and sand.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 低预算前往里约海滩时，[X]选择不带口袋的下装，只把手机、钱包和少量现金放进一个衣内隐蔽小袋，并在经过地铁、街道和沙滩前把非必要贵重物留在旅舍。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a solo backpacking route through La Paz markets, bus terminals, and high-altitude excursions, [X] selects lower garments with closed front pockets for the phone and daily wallet, keeping both items under direct attention even when the daypack moves to the front in crowds.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 独自背包游览拉巴斯市场、巴士站和高海拔地点时，[X]选择带可闭合前侧口袋的下装，用于手机和当日钱包；即使在人群中把日用背包转到身前，这两件物品仍处于直接注意范围。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a week in Bangkok and Krabi, [X] selects pocketless lower garments and uses one front-worn crossbody purse as the controlled cash system, separating daily small change from backup cards and larger notes before entering street-food and night-market crowds.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在曼谷和甲米旅行一周时，[X]选择不带口袋的下装，并把一个前背斜挎包作为唯一受控现金系统，在进入街头小吃和夜市人群前分开当日零钱、备用卡与大额纸币。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a crowded evening prayer at Kandy's Temple of the Sacred Tooth, [X] selects modest pocketless lower clothing and keeps the wallet and phone in one secure front crossbody carrier that remains visible while footwear is removed and the crowd compresses.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在康提佛牙寺拥挤的晚间祈祷中，[X]选择不带口袋的端庄下装，把钱包和手机放进一个安全的前背斜挎包，在脱鞋和人群收紧时仍保持可见。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While learning a repeatable home-laundry routine, [X] keeps the useful pockets on jeans and other heavy bottoms but adds a fixed pre-wash check for coins and tissues before separating the load from delicates.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 学习可重复执行的家庭洗衣流程时，[X]保留牛仔裤等厚重下装上的实用口袋，但在与精细衣物分开装机前，固定增加一次检查硬币和纸巾的步骤。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a first bike-food-delivery shift in a high-theft area, the rider compares keeping the navigation phone hidden in deep or closable trouser storage with using a handlebar mount, tether, top-tube bag, or backpack while repeatedly stopping to accept orders and check addresses.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在高失窃风险地区进行第一次自行车送餐班次时，骑手比较把导航手机藏在较深或可闭合的裤装收纳处，与使用车把支架、防丢绳、上管包或背包的差异，并需要反复停车接单和查看地址。
